claim_text: Public proteomic datasets covering zebrafish pronephros developmental windows W1-W4 (6-24 hpf) are scarce. Two datasets with confirmed PXD/MSV identifiers exist (PXD036678 pre-W1 MZT 4846 proteins; MSV000096671 post-W4 larval 4-10 dpf), but NEITHER covers W1-W4 directly. The most relevant timeseries dataset is Wan et al. JPR 2023 (PMID 37500539, 10 stages 4-cell to 5 dpf, 5961 proteins) which covers all four windows but PXD identifier is not localizable via PubMed abstract or web search — requires contacting authors. Sept7b is added as a new W4 candidate based on Fang 2024 iScience finding ('critical for pronephric function and left-right asymmetry').
framework_applied: Self-Discover (Tier 2) — per reasoning-frameworks-catalog.md §Tier 2. Sub-modules: M5 (repository enumeration), M6 (window-coverage classification), M7 (candidate elevation from proteomics-direct evidence).
expected_outcome_if_h1: Contacting Cuihong Wan (Wuhan) for the JPR 2023 PXD yields a deposited dataset accession (e.g., PXD0XXXXX) covering 10 stages from 4-cell to 5 dpf with 5961 proteins quantified. When queried for our 12 candidates, at least 8/12 are detected at protein level with stage-specific abundance changes matching the transcriptomic pattern.
expected_outcome_if_h0: Either (a) Wan's data is NOT deposited (inconsistent with JPR editorial policy but possible), or (b) deposit exists but most of our 12 candidates are below detection (suggesting transcript-protein discordance for TFs is large in early zebrafish embryos), or (c) detection is uneven across stages preventing window-by-window inference. In any of these cases, the substrate must operate on indirect / transcript-proxy evidence for Phase I.
observable_at: Once Wan lab responds to email request (typical academic turnaround: 1-4 weeks). Falsifiable by: searching ProteomeXchange Central for accessions submitted by Cuihong Wan or Central China Normal University labs in 2022-2023 timeframe.
